description_en: Queries a deduplicated list of version numbers of undeleted agent instances under a specified tenant, aggregated by agent provider and optionally filtered by agent platform. The results are returned in ascending order of version numbers
description_zh: 查询指定租户下、按 Agent 提供商（可选按 Agent 平台过滤）汇总的未删除 Agent 实例的去重版本号列表，结果按版本号升序返回
name: ListAgentInstanceVersions

parameters.help_en: The agent platform used to filter version numbers by business type. If this parameter is not specified, the default value ENTERPRISE is used
parameters.help_zh: Agent 平台，用于按业务形态过滤版本号；不传时默认按 ENTERPRISE（企业版）处理
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent provider
parameters.name: agent_provider

Data.description_en: The list of agent instance version numbers, which are deduplicated and sorted in ascending order
Data.description_zh: Agent 实例版本号列表，已按版本号去重并升序排列

items.description_en: The software version number of the agent instance. Special values such as latest and stable, or semantic version numbers such as 2.0.0 are supported
items.description_zh: Agent 实例的软件版本号，支持 latest、stable 等特殊值或语义化版本号（如 2.0.0）
